name: Hotel Landhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Landhof is located in the center of Ellmau in the Wilder Kaiser region. The traditional furnishings shape the ambiance of the house. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain backdrop of the Wilder Kaiser and hiking trails in summer as well as the ski area of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental in winter. The hotel has a wellness area with sauna, steam bath, and indoor pool. A restaurant with Tiroler Küche and a bar are available. The rooms are equipped with a balcony. Guests have access to hiking and ski bus service.
